FAT SNOW CABIN WITH A HAT ROOF: a squat little log cabin with a roof pulled down like a knitted hat, snow heaped to its two round windows, a crooked stovepipe with a single bend, a bent lantern post by the door, a frozen creek and dark spruce behind

SNOW-HATTED STONE HUT IN THE DRIFT: a round stone hut with a steep conical roof buried in snow, a chimney that leans and bends twice, a too-big arched door, one small round window, a stone well with its own tiny peaked roof half-drifted over, a spruce ring around

TWIN-GABLE SNOW LODGE WITH ICICLE FRINGE: a wide low lodge with twin gables side by side, icicles fringing every eave, a fat squat chimney with a curl at the top, a plank bridge over a frozen brook, a snow-mounded woodpile stacked beside the wall

CROOKED SNOW COTTAGE ON THE HILL: a tall thin cottage leaning gently left, fish-scale shingles frosted white, a chimney that bends once and puffs, a round door painted red, glowing moss clinging to the steps below the snow, a stand of birch on the slope behind

L-SHAPED SNOW FARMHOUSE WITH A BENT POST: an L-shaped farmhouse with one long low wing and a shorter gabled cap, snow to the windowsills, a crooked lantern post beside the corner, a weathervane shaped like a fox on the ridge, a frozen pond at the garden's edge

CROOKED COTTAGE IN THE MUSHROOM CLEARING: a tall thin cottage leaning slightly right, fish-scale shingles, a chimney that bends twice, a too-big round door, a ring of oversized glowing toadstools around the yard, giant oaks closing the clearing on all sides

MOSS-ROOFED CABIN AMONG THE GIANT OAKS: a fat squat single-gable cabin with a roof thick in green moss, a stubby crooked chimney, two tiny round windows, a garden of oversized flowers by the wall, the roots of enormous oaks lifting the stone path to the door

TREEHOUSE ON A PLATFORM IN THE PINES: a little gabled house on a timber platform high in the pines, a rope ladder dangling, a round window in the gable, a tin chimney pipe with a cap, a mailbox shaped like a bird nailed to the nearest trunk

LONG LOW CROOKED FOREST COTTAGE: a long low cottage with a crooked ridgeline that dips in the middle, shingles like fish scales, a chimney at each end both leaning inward, a plank door with an iron ring, ferns and giant mushrooms crowding the foundation stones

ROUND STONE HUT IN THE FERN HOLLOW: a round stone hut with a mushroom-cap roof of dark thatch, a single bent chimney, a too-big circular door banded in iron, tiny round windows on two sides, glowing mushrooms dotting the fern hollow floor around it

STUBBY LIGHTHOUSE-HOUSE ON THE CLIFF: a squat cottage with a crooked lamp room perched on top like a hat set sideways, fish-scale shingles, a round door facing the sea path, two square windows, a stone well at the cliff edge with a tiny peaked roof

STILT HUT OVER THE TIDE FLATS: a little plank hut on four fat wooden stilts above the tide flats, a gabled roof with a bent chimney pipe, one round window, a rope ladder to the door, a lantern on a bent post at the top of the ladder

ROUND STONE COTTAGE ON THE HEADLAND: a round stone cottage with a conical slate roof, a chimney that leans seaward, a too-big arched door painted blue, two small round windows, a weathervane shaped like a fish on the peak, gorse and sea-thrift around the base

TINY RIDGE HUT ABOVE THE SNOWLINE: a tiny single-gable hut of grey stone on a mountain ridge, a roof barely overhanging, a fat little chimney, one small window, a plank door braced with iron, a cairn of stacked stones beside the path leading up to it

ALPINE FARMHOUSE WITH A BELL TOWER: an L-shaped alpine farmhouse with a small square bell tower rising from the shorter wing, a broad overhanging roof, a crooked chimney, a stone well in the courtyard, a garden of oversized alpine flowers terraced on the slope below

STONE HERDSMAN'S HUT ON THE ALPINE MEADOW: a fat squat round-cornered stone hut on a high meadow shelf, a low gabled roof, a chimney with a stone cap, a round door, a tiny plank bridge over a mountain rill, wildflowers crowding the stones on every side

WINDMILL COTTAGE IN THE MEADOW: a fat round stone cottage with a windmill cap, four patched canvas sails, a little plank bridge over a brook, a stone well with its own tiny roof, a mailbox shaped like a bird at the gate, wildflowers to the door

SHEPHERD'S WAGON IN THE MEADOW: a rounded wooden shepherd's wagon on four big wheels, a barrel-vaulted roof painted green, a half-door at the back, two tiny square windows with flower boxes, a bent lantern post driven into the ground beside it, tall meadow grass all around

MILL COTTAGE WITH A BIG WHEEL BY THE STREAM: a squat single-gable mill cottage with a big wooden wheel turning in the stream beside it, a fat chimney, a round door, a stone bridge of three arches over the brook, an oversized flower garden along the millrace wall

ROUNDED ADOBE HOUSE WITH A BLUE DOOR: a rounded single-storey adobe house with a flat roof edged in terracotta pots, a blue arched door, two small square windows with blue frames, a weathervane shaped like a fox on a post, candy-striped sandstone fins rising behind

STONE HOMESTEAD AMONG THE CANDY-STRIPED ROCKS: a long low flat-roofed stone homestead with a short square chimney, a plank door banded in iron, three small windows, a stone well under a tiny roof in the yard, tall candy-striped red and white rock pillars all around

BAMBOO STILT HOUSE BY THE RIVER: a bamboo stilt house on six poles above the river shallows, a palm-thatch gabled roof with a curl at the ridge, a round door, two small square windows, a rope ladder, a lantern on a bent bamboo post at the landing

PALM-HAT HUT ON THE BEACH: a round hut with a palm-thatch roof shaped like a wide hat pulled low, a plank door painted yellow, one round window, a mailbox shaped like a bird on a driftwood post, oversized tropical flowers growing in a ring around the base

BOATHOUSE ON PILINGS WITH A LANTERN: a long low boathouse on timber pilings over the marsh water, a gabled roof, a crooked chimney, a wide plank door on rollers, two small round windows, a lantern on a bent post at the end of the dock

REED-THATCHED ROUND HOUSE ON THE SHORE: a round house with a tall conical reed-thatch roof, a bent chimney at the peak, a too-big arched door, two small round windows, glowing mushrooms along the stone foundation, bulrushes and water lilies edging the marshy shore around it
